properties.name: locale
properties.description: BCP-47 locale for built-in accessible labels (English, Arabic, Romanian).

properties.name: variant
properties.description:
Layout variant.
- `inline` (default) — picker UI is always visible.
- `popover` — opens the picker in a floating panel anchored to itself,
  behind a trigger YOU slot into `trigger`. There is no built-in trigger.

properties.name: value
properties.description:
Current value. Accepts any 3/4/6/8-digit hex, `rgb()`, `rgba()`, or
the formats emitted by this component. Two-way bindable.

properties.name: alpha
properties.description: Show the alpha slider + alpha hex field.

properties.name: showHex
properties.description: Show the hex input field below the sliders.

properties.name: presets
properties.description:
Swatch presets. When non-empty, a small palette appears below the sliders
for one-tap colour selection.

Takes either form, so it behaves like every other list-valued prop in the
library rather than being the one exception:
  - attribute — `presets="#000000,#FFFFFF,#FF5722"` (comma-separated)
  - property  — `el.presets = ['#000000', '#FFFFFF', '#FF5722']`

properties.name: ariaLabelProp
properties.description: Accessible label for the whole picker. Defaults to "Color picker".

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the popover is open. Only meaningful when variant=`popover`.

properties.name: dismissOnOutsideClick
properties.description:
When true and `variant="popover"`, clicking outside the component
closes the open panel. Defaults to `false` so existing popovers keep
their current behaviour until opted in.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Color Picker
description: Pick an arbitrary colour. A saturation/value plate with hue and optional alpha sliders, numeric fields in hex / RGB / HSL, and an optional preset swatch row. Renders inline or as a popover behind a trigger you supply.

notes: Dedicated native renderers (SwiftUI AWCNativeColorPicker, Compose NativeColorPicker): the saturation / value plate, the hue and alpha tracks, the hex and channel fields, the presets, the inline variant and the popover with the consumer's trigger in the trigger slot.

The eleven source hooks through AWCColorPickerAppearance (.awcColorPickerAppearance(_:) / AWCColorPickerAppearanceScope): lengths in points / dp, #RRGGBB(AA) colours and the popover elevation as CSS box-shadow text.

Methods through AWCColorPickerController: show() and close() act on a popover picker (show() not while disabled), emit mdOpenChange, and close() returns focus that was inside the popover to the trigger.

mdInput only when the formatted value changes and mdChange on commit; keyboard steps with RTL-mirrored arrows; Escape is claimed inside an md-dialog. macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against the Chrome 153 oracles (paint and interaction).
